key_findings: Intrathecal BMSCs alleviated thermal, mechanical, spontaneous and cold pain in CRPS-I rats.
BMSCs reversed the CRPS-I-induced upregulation of Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 mRNA and protein in DRG and normalized sodium I-V curves.
